steps.goal: Strengthen parent-child communication and establish a home environment where teens feel safe to express themselves.

steps.goal: Introduce parents to therapeutic methods (DBT, CBT, mindfulness) they can use to support their teen's emotional regulation.

steps.title: Supporting Recovery and Resilience
steps.goal: Help teens develop skills to recover from depressive episodes and grow emotional resilience.

steps.title: Long-Term Growth and Prevention
steps.goal: Promote long-term mental wellness and prepare for life beyond the depressive episode.
